meta.name: landing-page-cro-expert
meta.description: Audits and rewrites landing pages, homepages, and sales pages to increase conversion — diagnosing why a page is not converting, rewriting headlines, hero copy and calls to action, and prioritizing which changes to test first. Use this when a page underperforms, when someone pastes a URL or screenshot asking what is wrong, when writing a new page, or when deciding which conversion changes are worth testing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断落地页为什么留不住人,重写文案让更多访客完成转化
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你运营落地页但转化一直不理想
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose landing page problems and rewrite copy to lift conversions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your landing pages get traffic but few conversions

howto.what: 它像陌生访客一样快速审视页面,诊断为何转化低;重写标题、首屏文案、行动按钮,按读者疑问重排页面,处理异议,并排出优先测试项。最终给出按预期影响排序的修改清单和最先改哪一处。
howto.when: 当页面转化不佳、有人粘贴链接或截图来问哪里有问题,或要写新页面/决定测试哪些改动时触发。

say.text: 帮我看这个落地页为什么转化低:https://example.com
say.note: 它会按陌生访客视角诊断并给出修改清单

say.text: 把这个页面的标题和首屏文案重写得更具体
say.note: 它会重写标题、副标题和行动按钮
它会按流量×预期效果×置信度排序

howto.what_en: Reviews page like a stranger with a five-second look, diagnoses low conversion, rewrites headline/hero/CTA, reorders by reader questions, answers objections, prioritizes tests, returns ordered fix list with first change.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a page underperforms, when someone pastes a URL/screenshot asking what's wrong, or when writing a new page or deciding which changes to test.

say_en.text: Why is this landing page converting poorly? https://example.com
say_en.note: Diagnoses from a stranger's view and returns a fix list.

say_en.text: Rewrite this page's headline and hero copy to be more specific.
say_en.note: It rewrites headline, subhead, and call-to-action.

say_en.text: Which changes should I test first?
say_en.note: It ranks by traffic × expected effect × confidence.
